channel.title: Republic of Congo - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Republic of Congo, every source cited.

item.title: Congolese civil society seeks say on timber revenue
item.description: A new law requires 15% of felled timber to go to the state, but implementation details remain unclear.

item.title: Colonel Rémy Ayayos Ikounga Dikanono named deputy Grand Master of Congo's Masonic Lodge
item.description: The appointment follows the dismissal of Jean-Dominique Okemba in April, with a close associate of Edgar Nguesso taking the role.
